LPLinkMetadata.doc: An object that contains metadata about a URL.

LPLinkView.doc: A rich visual representation of a link.

LPMetadataProvider.doc: An object that retrieves metadata for a URL.

LPErrorCode.doc: Possible error values that can be returned from LinkPresentation APIs.

-initWithMetadata:.doc: Initializes a link view with specified metadata.

-initWithURL:.doc: Initializes a placeholder link view without metadata for a given URL.

-startFetchingMetadataForRequest:complet.doc: Fetches metadata for the given NSURLRequest.

-startFetchingMetadataForURL:completionH.doc: Fetches metadata for the given URL.

URL.doc: The URL that returned the metadata, taking server-side redirects into account.

iconProvider.doc: An object that retrieves data corresponding to a representative icon for the URL.

imageProvider.doc: An object that retrieves data corresponding to a representative image for the URL.

originalURL.doc: The original URL of the metadata request.

remoteVideoURL.doc: A remote URL corresponding to a representative video for the URL.

title.doc: A representative title for the URL.

videoProvider.doc: An object that retrieves data corresponding to a representative video for the URL.

metadata.doc: The metadata from which to generate a rich presentation.

shouldFetchSubresources.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether to download subresources specified by the metadata.

timeout.doc: The time interval after which the request automatically fails if it hasn’t already completed.
